ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-to-moderate; dominant low-intensity dark-grey pixels (base pigmentation) punctuated by sparse high-intensity white pixel clusters (scarring).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern across both trailing edges. Right lobe exhibits higher-amplitude jagged peaks and valleys; left lobe displays more frequent, lower-amplitude micro-serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular white rings (barnacle scars) detected across the ventral surface, with high density on the right lobe and inner-left lobe regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct cluster of 4-5 parallel, diagonal high-intensity linear marks (rake marks) on the medial section of the right lobe; several individual horizontal and vertical white scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring including parallel rake marks and numerous circular barnacle attachment sites; no visible evidence of fluke amputations or large-scale trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent dark vertical midline ridge extending from the base toward the median notch.
